title: One adoption check replaces three (S28)
body:
Source: Fable architecture decision 2026-11-15, docs/program/plan.md S28 (Sector 7 — Onboarding (ADR 0023)); program t-b160jt0.
Why: ADR 0023 — moves the north-star items named in the plan sector. Counts toward the slop cut t-jgent6a.
Outcome: verify, canary and the walkthrough merge into `krn adopt --verify`; census moves to evals/adoption; unused and host-remediation fold or go
Files: see ADR 0023 Consequences.
Proof: `find src/adopt -name '*.ts' | xargs cat | wc -l: <= 2450`
Predicted: outside adopt >= 1 in >= 5 rows
After: S27
